counterfactual_missing_items: No explicit small-cell cytology with scant cytoplasm is described
No hypercalcemia is reported to support the hypercalcemic small-cell subtype
No immunohistochemical neuroendocrine marker results are provided
decisive_items: predominantly trabecular and rosette-like formations of pleomorphic hyperchromatic tumor cells
response.rationale: R5 best integrates the neuroendocrine marker elevation (NSE) with the trabecular/rosette-like architecture and poorly differentiated high-mitotic ovarian carcinoma, favoring small cell carcinoma of the ovary. R3 is a broader high-grade ovarian carcinoma label that fits the malignancy but does not account for the rosette-like/NSE features; R1 lacks serous-specific morphology; R2 is merely descriptive; R4 is nonspecific.

rejected.why: No papillary/serous architecture or psammoma bodies; CA125 and peritoneal implants are nonspecific.
Poorly differentiated carcinoma is a descriptive histologic label, not the most likely specific diagnosis.
Ovarian cancer is too broad and does not capture the neuroendocrine/rosette-like features.
